sources.title: Planning Data documentation
sources.facts: API access to over 100 datasets; coordinate queries; planning-application specification currently in development and may change
sources.guard: API capability does not prove completeness, currentness, legal effect or exact-site correctness.

sources.title: Planning Data datasets catalogue
sources.facts: 56 geography, 30 category, 6 legal instrument, 6 document, 11 organisation, 4 policy, 2 metric and 1 timetable dataset groupings
sources.guard: Catalogue inclusion and dataset counts do not prove national completeness or operational readiness.

sources.title: Conservation area Dataset
sources.origin: Mixed authoritative, Historic England and MHCLG-created data; explicitly incomplete with duplicates
sources.facts: 11,007 records; 158 providers; collector and new data 2026-07-27
sources.guard: Fresh collection does not resolve incompleteness, duplicates, designation currency or exact boundary questions.

sources.title: Local plan boundary Dataset
sources.origin: Planning Data; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
sources.guard: Boundary catalogue does not by itself prove current plan applicability or legal status.

sources.title: Flood risk zone Dataset
sources.facts: 780,636 records; 1 provider; collector 2023-11-01; new data 2023-08-24; zones cannot tell whether a location will definitely flood or severity
sources.guard: Authoritative origin does not remove stale-collection or deterministic-flood limitations.

sources.title: Local plan Dataset
sources.origin: Planning Data; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
sources.facts: 1,050 plans; 65 providers; collector 2026-07-27; new data 2026-07-25; current, emerging and historical rows coexist
sources.guard: A catalogue row is not proof that a plan is adopted, in force, applicable or legally current.

sources.title: Planning application condition Dataset
sources.origin: Planning Data; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
sources.guard: Condition catalogue is not evidence of discharge, compliance, current application status or exact-site acceptability.

sources.title: Design code area type Dataset
sources.origin: Planning Data; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
sources.facts: 10 category entries; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-26; new data 2024-06-11
sources.guard: Category vocabulary is not a design-code area, policy requirement or site result.
